table.name: FINREV_FED_17
table.purpose: Federal revenue received by U.S. public school districts (local education agencies) for fiscal year 2017, one row per school district. Matches the U.S. Census Bureau F-33 survey / NCES school district finance format (state FIPS, 14-digit Census LEA ID, NCES LEA ID, year code 17).

col_001.name: state_fips_code
col_001.description: FIPS code of the state in which the school district is located (1-51). References FINREV_FED_KEY_17.col_001, which maps the code to the state name (e.g. 44 = Texas, 51 = Wyoming).

col_002.name: census_lea_id
col_002.description: 14-digit Census Bureau school-district (LEA) identifier. Structure follows the F-33 layout: state FIPS (2) + county-ish sequence + suffix, e.g. 36 5047 011 00000 for LORAIN CITY SCH DIST in Ohio. Unique per row.

col_003.name: lea_name
col_003.description: Name of the school district / local education agency (e.g. 'LORAIN CITY SCH DIST', 'LA PORTE COMMUNITY SCHOOL CORPORATION').

col_004.name: nces_lea_id
col_004.description: NCES (National Center for Education Statistics) 7-character LEA ID for the district, stored as text (e.g. '3904426' for Lorain City, matching Ohio's 39 FIPS prefix). Unique per row.

col_005.name: fiscal_year_code
col_005.description: Survey/fiscal-year identifier, constant value 17 for all rows, i.e. fiscal year 2017 (consistent with the table name suffix _17).

col_006.name: federal_revenue_total
col_006.description: Total federal revenue for the district, in U.S. dollars (values range 0 to ~2.06 million; median ~880). Largest of the three money columns, so plausibly the total federal revenue figure. However, the specific F-33 line item it maps to (e.g. C11 total vs. a subtotal) cannot be confirmed from the data alone.

col_007.name: federal_revenue_component_1
col_007.description: A component of federal revenue in dollars (0 to ~957k, median 189; zero for ~1,644 districts). Likely a specific federal program line item (e.g. Title I / child nutrition), but the exact program cannot be determined from the data alone.

col_008.name: federal_revenue_component_2
col_008.description: A second component of federal revenue in dollars (0 to ~439k, median 232; zero for ~1,610 districts). Likely another federal program line item (e.g. special education), but the exact program cannot be determined from the data alone.

table.name: FINREV_FED_KEY_17
table.purpose: Lookup/key table for the 50 U.S. states plus the District of Columbia (51 rows), used to key the FINREV_FED_17 table (likely federal education revenue data, FY2017). Each row is one state with an ID and a numeric code.

col_001.name: state_id
col_001.description: Primary key: sequential integer 1-51 identifying each state (plus DC). Referenced by FINREV_FED_17.col_001 as a foreign key.

col_002.name: state_name
col_002.description: State name (50 states plus District of Columbia), unique per row. Joins one-to-one to NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8.col_002.

col_003.name: state_code
col_003.description: Numeric code per state, stored as text with occasional thousands separators (e.g. '1,045'). Values range roughly 1-983 with 48 distinct values (some codes shared by two states). Likely a FIPS-like or NCES state code, but the exact coding scheme is not confirmed; could also be a Census/NCES agency ID. Marked tentative.

table.name: NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8
table.purpose: NAEP (National Assessment of Educational Progress) 2017 Grade 8 Mathematics average scale scores by state, for all students. One row per state/jurisdiction (50 states, DC, National, etc.).

col_001.name: year
col_001.description: Assessment year; constant 2017 for all rows.

col_002.name: state
col_002.description: State or jurisdiction name (e.g., Alabama, National). Primary key of this table; also referenced by FINREV_FED_KEY_17.col_002, linking NAEP scores to federal education finance data.

col_003.name: student_group
col_003.description: Student subgroup assessed; constant 'All students' in this table (no breakdown by subgroup here).

col_004.name: avg_math_scale_score
col_004.description: NAEP Grade 8 mathematics average scale score for the state, ranging 266-297 (NAEP scale 0-500).
